row.team_price_text: Early: $27/mo flat, billed monthly (no per-user fees)
row.evidence: Xero's US pricing page lists Early, Growing and Established with 'No per-user license fees' and no SSO or SCIM, and the Accounting API Users endpoint is GET-only, but the Xero Central help centre could not be searched to confirm absence.
row.notes: Status changed from none to unknown because the help centre (central.xero.com) could not be loaded by any method and the login page now offers 'Log in with SSO', so June's 'no native SSO' claim could not be re-verified; re-check from a browser. Prices changed: Early is now $27/mo (June $15), Growing $59, Established $97, monthly billing only, flat with unlimited users. June's notes about miniOrange proxies and customers asking publicly for Entra/SCIM had no first-party source and are dropped. Okta's Xero app is SWA only. The Accounting API exposes a read-only Users endpoint (list users and roles).

scim.notes: No SCIM on the pricing page, security page or developer API reference; the Xero Central help centre could not be loaded, so absence is not established.

endpoints.purpose: List users for a Xero organisation (UserID, email, names, IsSubscriber, OrganisationRole)

user_api.notes: Read-only: the Accounting API Users endpoint supports GET only (list users and roles of an organisation); no create, update or remove. Plan/API-access terms were not checked.

okta.notes: OIN 'Xero' app ticks SWA only (last updated Jan 2021).

conflicts.text: June's row said Xero has no native SSO, but the Xero login page now carries a 'Log in with SSO' button and a 'Learn more about Single Sign On (SSO)' help link (hidden until an SSO domain is detected). What this SSO covers (SAML/OIDC with a customer IdP, or social sign-in) could not be confirmed.

searched: https://central.xero.com/s/article/Log-into-Xero (help centre: curl returns a JS shell, WebFetch empty, renderer ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES / ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED)
open_questions: What 'Log in with SSO' on login.xero.com supports (SAML/OIDC with which IdPs, which plans) is undocumented in the pages that loaded; the linked Xero Central article could not be loaded.
Whether Xero offers SCIM or any automated provisioning: Xero Central could not be searched, so 'none by absence' is not established.
Whether API access for customers' own integrations is restricted by plan or by Xero's developer pricing tiers was not checked.
Entra, Google, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue listings not found or not loadable.
